title: Central Visayas dengue deaths reach 119, surpass 2025 record

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Dengue deaths in Central Visayas have reached 119 as the region recorded 21,357 cases from Jan. 4 to Nov. 14, 2026, according to the Department of Health in Central Visayas (DOH-7). The death toll has already exceeded the 22 deaths recorded during the same period in 2025, prompting concern from DOH-7 even as this year’s case count may not be the highest recorded in previous years. Dengue cases across Central Visayas Cebu Province accounted for the largest share of the region’s cases, recording 7,816 infections and 40 deaths.
